test_case.name: OOM Kill (Container Memory Limit Exceeded)
test_case.scenario_description: An ML recommendation worker container ('recommendation-worker') in pod 'recommendation-engine-6b8f9c4d2-x7v2p' (namespace 'ml-serving') loads a dense vector embedding index during a traffic spike, exceeding its 512Mi cgroup memory limit. The Linux kernel OOM killer dispatches SIGKILL (exit code 137), and kubelet marks the container OOMKilled before entering CrashLoopBackOff.
test_case.injected_fault: Container memory allocation (548Mi) exceeds resources.limits.memory (512Mi), triggering kernel cgroup OOM killer (SIGKILL / exit code 137).
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Container 'recommendation-worker' in pod 'recommendation-engine-6b8f9c4d2-x7v2p' was terminated by the Linux kernel Out-Of-Memory (OOM) killer with exit code 137 (SIGKILL) after exceeding its 512Mi cgroup memory limit, triggering repeated CrashLoopBackOff restarts.
